items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The transcript contains no [INTERVIEWEE] turns. The mention of René Lodge is made by the [INTERVIEWER] ('Big Al Lowy played with René Lodge too') and the [INTERVIEWER] ('René was your favorite'). Without the interviewee's response or narration, no personal relationship can be established.

ctx.x: Now, who would be your favorite trumpet player as long as that time? Who was your name as some of the outstanding people?
Well, I said René. René was your favorite. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
And who was your name after René? Bass brother.
